subject.title: fix(agents): carry provenance through active subagent wakes

question: Should `inputProvenance` become a public `AgentSession.steer`/plugin SDK option, or should active-wake provenance stay on an internal queue/helper surface?
rationale: The PR solves an internal session-state bug, but its current shape adds a public SDK-visible steering option and budget increase without maintainer-visible API direction.

options.title: Keep Provenance Internal
options.body: Rebase the PR so provenance flows through internal active-wake queue options while the public `AgentSession.steer` API keeps its existing contract, including the transcript recorder.

options.title: Approve Public Steering Provenance
options.body: Accept `inputProvenance` as a plugin-visible API and require docs/tests that define who may set it and how it interacts with transcript persistence.

options.title: Pause This PR
options.body: Hold the branch until the broader provenance and active steering API direction is settled with related subagent/session-state work.

recommendation.title: Keep Provenance Internal
recommendation.body: Rebase the PR so provenance flows through internal active-wake queue options while the public `AgentSession.steer` API keeps its existing contract, including the transcript recorder.

likelyOwner.reason: The existing provenance helper history and subagent announce ownership trail make steipete the best available routing candidate for the public-versus-internal API decision.
